author: LFT
body:
Hey everyone,

I have decided to giveaway one of my alt's I've had for almost 4 years now.
The account's current name is 'Trover' and has a name change on it. 
I am not sure if it has any ranks, but from my knowledge it does not.

**How to enter**

Follow the instructions on the gleam and it will give you entries that help your chances!
https://gleam.io/competitions/fdWyS-alt-account-giveaway

*If you're already subscribed or following and you do not get extra entries for that, unsubscribed/unfollow then refollow/subscribe*
You can say that you've entered if you'd like, but its not needed if you did the entries.


Ends: 6/14/17
